title: Qualify exact Math temperature conversion in Ubuntu WSL Linux x64 net11 consumer
commitMessage: test: qualify Math temperature Linux WSL net11 consumer

contribution.summary: Verify real Linux x64 .NET 11 Math temperature conversions against the independently qualified RS239 canonical values.
contribution.value: Reuse the RS241 qualified WSL SDK11 login-shell and isolated nine-file quantities source consumer. Compile and run under Linux x64, verify Celsius/Fahrenheit affine and interval semantics, plus absolute temperature addition refusal. No production or package changes.
debtChanges: RS241 succeeded at attempt 001 after one preselection refusal; firstPassSucceeded=false and Linux Math source execution is durable.
RS242 extends real Linux source behavior to the exact RS239 temperature oracle without claiming package binary compatibility or M8 readiness.
RS242 failed preselection before attempt allocation: Linux C# compiler CS7036 in probe-only new ExactRational(10); corrected to explicit numerator and denominator (10,1).
